items.description: أنتم السابقون هي تجربة رعب نفسية وتعاونية تنافسية، تمزج بين التوتر، التعاون، والخوف من المجهول في لعبة أونلاين مشوقة من منظور الشخص الأول ومنظور الشخص الثالثفي كل جولة، يتم اختيار لاعب واحد لتجسيد الوحش – كائن غامض وقاتل، يطارد ضحاياه في الظلام مستخدمًا الرؤية الليلية، التسلل، والوحشيةأما الثلاثة الآخرون، فهم ناجون بشر، عليهم العمل معًا لحل لغز الخريطة، العثور على الأدوات، وتفادي الوحش قبل فوات الأوانكل خريطة في اللعبة مصممة بأجواء فريدة وألغاز مختلفة، مما يجعل كل جولة تجربة جديدة كليًا. ستجد نفسك في مصحات مهجورة، غابات مظلمة، أو أنقاض مدمرة، وكل مكان يحمل سره الخاص🎙️ التواصل الصوتي داخل اللعبة هو سلاحك الأقوى… أو نقطة ضعفك.الناجون يمكنهم التواصل عبر المايك للتعاون، لكن الوحش قد يسمع كل شيء. فهل ستهمس أم تصرخ؟ Subscribe to our newsletter Get STEAM deals and FREE games in your inbox Game developers Want your game sold on DailyIndieGame? items.description: GORF the FrogJump. Survive. Cross.In a world filled with dangers and mysteries, embody a lost frog searching for its true purpose. All you know is that you must get to the other side of the road... but is that really all there is to it?GORF reimagines the classic arcade game Frogger through the lens of modern action RPGs, bringing unprecedented depth to the road-crossing experience with its pixel art aesthetics and uncompromising soulslike gameplay.KEY FEATURES:🐸 Strategic Road-Crossing Master the art of survival as you navigate treacherous streets. Plan your route, avoid dangers, and use the environment to your advantage. One mistake could be your last.⚔️ Brutal Gameplay Face challenging encounters in a souls-like combat system where timing and strategy are key. Learn from your defeats, adapt your approach, and overcome seemingly impossible odds.🌟 Character Progression Deep RPG systems let you customize your frog's abilities to match your playstyle. Unlock new skills and discover creative ways to tackle increasingly challenging roads.🤝 Complex World Meet fascinating allies and terrifying enemies in a world where appearances deceive. Trust must be earned, and some of your fiercest opponents might become your strongest allies.UNCOVER THE TRUTHWhat lies behind the seemingly simple task of crossing the road? Why has the world become so dangerous? Uncover the dark secrets behind your journey and face the truth about your destiny.PREPARE FOR:Diverse environments with unique hazards and challengesExperience-based character progressionExtensive locations with alternative pathsAn engaging story full of unexpected twistsMultiple attempts at difficult challengesEpic boss battles that test your skills and witGameplay time ranging from 30 minutes to 3 hoursPerformance-based ranking system with S-tier time ratings and A-tier for other achievements, leading to Perfect Score when maxed outDo you have enough courage and determination to help the frog discover the truth? Jump, fight, and survive in GORF - where road-crossing becomes an epic life adventure.GORF is the debut production from an independent studio, combining timeless arcade action with modern game design philosophies. items.description: DreamRace is a high-speed arcade racing runner where you blast through 30 levels across six unique worlds. From the neon streets of a nighttime metropolis to the crater of a volcano and the depths of outer space, each biome offers new challenges.Dodge enemy cars, collect stars, activate nitro and a shield, and create combo chains. Upgrade your speed and maneuverability, unlock new skins and color schemes.Bosses—special enemies with a health bar—are waiting along the way, requiring you to outrun or destroy them. Rain, snow, and clear skies change the atmosphere of each race.Supports keyboard, gamepad, and mobile touch controls.Four languages: Russian, English, Georgian, and Romanian.High scores, quests, and level selection—all in one game! items.description: Welcome to Definitely Not a Cult, a game about running a “completely normal” community where everything is a little too friendly, a little too weird, and a little too cult-adjacent to be an accident. Build, upgrade, gather resources, unlock new systems, and keep your members in line while trying to maintain the illusion that everything is under control. Even when it clearly is not.If you like games where comfort slowly turns into suspicion, and suspicion turns into a meme, you are in the right place.The pyramid is watching. The town is whispering. Everyone is acting normal. That should worry you.Features:meme-heavy atmosphere with low-key paranoia;base and community management;strange characters and even stranger events;achievements;Russian and English localization. items.description: Knight`s Pride is a sort of an incremental RPG game...This game isn`t rich storywise! A JOB?? Grab your toolkit and do what every support engineer does best: walk into chaos and pretend this is a normal workday.
